(I hope I can commit myself finally to something after a long vacation break hehe)

Aryan!

Built something this weekend that I genuinely wished existed simply: 

The Typewriter: it is a cozy, atmospheric web typewriter for people who just want to write without the noise.

Also this was my first time using any vibe coding tool and I had to break my head over it but I got over it and now we will be building more cool stuff simply for the love of the craft hehe.

(I am putting my Claude subscription to good use and I absolutely love it!)

You can open it, start typing, and your words land on warm lamp-lit paper. Ink imperfections, soft typewriter sounds, a paper roll that scrolls as you go. No accounts, no cloud, no distractions and everything saves locally in your browser.

A few things it does:
 — Type and watch the page roll up as you fill it
 — Press Esc for a fresh sheet
 — Shred a page if it doesn't deserve to exist 
 — End a session to see your tally — time, words, characters, pages
 — and export as a PDF — A little "closet" to browse and revisit past sessions

As someone who's spent way too many hours writing in tabs with seventeen other tabs open, I wanted something that felt like a small space you come back to to feel like a medieval writer working on your typewriter, and not just a tool. Just you, the paper, and the sound of keys.

This is v1. More features coming — but it already does what I needed it to do.

GitHub link: https://lnkd.in/gCqp5w8m

Would love for fellow writers to try it and tell me what's missing.

Cheers!
